task.description: GH-732 / ISS-0685: Fix NFR-04 bench replay_10000_ms — was measuring synthetic nfr_bench_events full table scan with no bounded predicate. Fix: add instance_id + sequence_number columns to nfr_bench_events (matching real events schema), seed with instance_id=run_id, compute first/last event time window (mirroring eventWindowForInstanceInTx), issue PAR-06 bounded query: WHERE instance_id=$1 AND created_at >= $2 AND created_at < $3 ORDER BY sequence_number ASC.

result.summary: Updated measureReplayMs() in tests/bench/bench.zig to use PAR-06 bounded query predicate. ensureBenchTable adds instance_id/sequence_number columns and (instance_id, created_at) index. seedEvents sets instance_id=run_id. measureReplayMs does window lookup then bounded query. zig build exit 0. PR #740 squash-merged to main.
